name: com.smpro.inspector
description: Attribute-driven inspectors for Unity 6. Group fields into boxes, foldouts and tabs, show or enable fields from other values, turn methods into buttons, validate references and values, and build editor windows with the same attributes. Runs on UI Toolkit and Unity's own serialization.

samples.description: A spawner and two enemy profiles that use most attributes, a broken profile for the validator, and two example tool windows.
